_about: SINGLE CONTROL DOCUMENT for the whole platform. Edit this one file to re-brand it, set your organisation's details (name, logo, contact, social links), change standard wording (welcome messages, footer, errors), or toggle which dynamic widgets/badges appear. Loaded by core.branding; exposed to every template as `brand` / `org` / `dynamic` / `site` / `strings` (see core.context_processors.branding) and to Python via `from core.branding import t, BRAND, ORG`. Placeholders like {name} are filled with str.format() — keep them.
_sections: ORGANISATION (your details + logo + contact + social) → see `brand`.  STANDARD WORDING → `brand.welcome`, `meta`, `auth`, `messages`, `errors`, `footer`.  DYNAMIC ELEMENTS (badges/widgets/banner you can turn on/off) → `dynamic`.  CUSTOM SITE-WIDE VALUES injected into every page → `site`.

brand._about: Your organisation's identity. Everything here flows into the navbar, sidebar, footer, e-mails and auth pages automatically.
brand.name: Metanoia Group
brand._registered_note: Company details printed in the Terms & Conditions (ECTA s43). Fill in registration_number, vat_number, directors and information_officer — a blank value is left out of the terms rather than printed empty.
brand.description: Metanoia Group: B-BBEE verification, transformation consulting, skills development and learning for organisations across South Africa.
brand._favicon_note: Leave `favicon` EMPTY to use the generated set in static/images/icons/ (favicon-16/32/180) — browsers then pick the right size per context, which is why the tab icon stays sharp. Set it to a single path only if you want to override all of them with one file.
brand._policy_note: Linked from the small print of every e-mail. Terms live on the LMS; the privacy policy is the public website's.
brand._invoice_name_note: How the business signs financial documents. The invoice template writes the trading name in a different word order to the platform name, so it is kept separate rather than reusing `name`.

contact._about: `whatsapp` is what is DISPLAYED; `whatsapp_url` is what is LINKED. Keep them in step — a wa.me link must be digits only, with the country code and no '+', spaces or brackets.
contact.address: Metanoia House, 86 Fleet Street, Ferndale, Randburg, Gauteng 2194, South Africa
contact.postal_address: PostNet Suite 78, Private Bag X14, Pinegowrie, Gauteng 2123

banking._about: Printed under Notes / Terms on every invoice PDF. The reference students must use is built per invoice (Invoice.payment_reference), not stored here.

links._about: Outbound destinations used by the landing page's call-to-action buttons. Leave a value empty to hide that button.

social._about: Full URLs only: each value becomes a link. Leave one empty to hide its icon (no Facebook, X or Instagram page is published on the website yet).

welcome.title: Welcome!
welcome.subtitle: Sign in to continue to your learning.
welcome.signup_subtitle: Join Metanoia in a few clicks.

brand.copyright: Copyright © 2026 Metanoia Group. All rights reserved.

dynamic._about: Turn the live, data-driven elements of the UI on/off from here. `badges` control the unread/pending counters; `widgets` control floating/quick tools; `announcement` shows a site-wide banner. Read in templates as `dynamic.badges.*` etc.

landing._about: The public landing page (templates/pages/landing.html). `nav` is the in-page jump list shown in the floating navbar — each `href` MUST match an id= on a section of that page, or the link scrolls nowhere (apps/myhub/tests.py fails the build if one doesn't). Re-point or trim these per organisation; the navbar loops over whatever is here. The footer no longer has a link column — it is a single centred contact line built from `brand.contact`.

site._about: Arbitrary site-wide values injected into EVERY template context (as `site.<key>`). Add anything you want available everywhere — a promo line, a phone for the header, a banner image — without touching code.
